title: Vigorous Chewy Ukrainian Oats Dumplings
description: A macrobiotic friendly Ukrainian dish featuring cocoa powder and char-grill yang, perfect for a post-workout meal
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the oats, cocoa powder, and sea salt
In a separate bowl, whisk together the water, char-grill yang sauce, and maple syrup
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until a dough forms
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour
Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side
Brush the dumplings with coconut oil and serve warm
